capture_required: No common position update is available.
Manual/Event recording: save all participating objects after their simulation step, before accepting moves.
capture_stale: The latest update is older than the allowed record gap.
Resume recording; do not replace missing evidence with current client data.
invalid_capture_time: Recording time is outside the allowed range
The timestamp is invalid, in the future, or too far behind the selected clock.
Use seconds from the same server clock for simulation, providers and Capture.
non_monotonic: A timestamp was equal to or older than the previous recording.
Record once per completed simulation step, with strictly increasing times.
move_already_checked: This move already used its check
Once mode allows one successful contact query.
For a continuous active window select Repeated. Target limits still apply to the whole move.
duplicate_query: This move was already checked at the latest recorded instant.
Wait for a newer Capture before checking this repeated move again.
rewind_rejected: The timing provider failed or returned a delay outside the configured maximum.
Check the server timing rule, shared clock and saved-history range. Raw client timestamps need independent validation.
timing_player_required: Choose the player for this object
Measured-ping timing could not identify a connected Player.
For data-only objects, map the object to its owner inside Hooks.TimingPlayer, or use a timing provider.
world_unknown: The obstacle provider cannot prove what blocked this query time.
Check the selected folder/provider, anchored bounds and changes since the requested time. Do not assume missing cover was clear.
provider_has_not_approved_position: The selected provider did not return ok=true.
Connect a server calculation/checker inside the supplied provider module. Reading a player-owned Part alone is not a movement check.
client_owned_position_needs_checker: Server-physics mode found an object whose physics a player controls.
Select a suitable position checker. Do not change its trust label to bypass this refusal.
position_function_error: A data function errored, yielded or reentered Connector.
Fix the supplied provider or Hooks, then reset the affected object with Discontinuity/Resume before recording again.
contact_result_stale: Too much time passed between finding a contact and applying its result.
Apply within the permitted record gap and recheck current game rules.
contact_records_changed: An object was reset, replaced, added or removed after the contact check.
Start a fresh accepted move after the required records are available.
waiting_for_capture: Manual/Event mode does not record automatically.
Call Capture after completing a common simulation step, or fire the selected recording event.
action_spent: This move has already returned the allowed total number of different targets.
Finish it. Repeated checks never reset the whole-move target limit.
ready_for_moves: Link the accepted move, its hit moment and cancellation; inspect actual outcomes in Play.
contact_check_completed: The query had usable evidence. An empty contact list means a miss.
Use the returned targets and keep current game outcome rules in charge.
